newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse pauses before New Year.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse pauses before New Year.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Monday higher but with no marked change in trend as the market took a break before starting a new year, brokers said.
The all-share index ended up 0.47 percent at 446.21 points, up from 444.12 points on Friday.
"It has been a good year, people usually prefer to keep their gains rather than taking risks at the eve of a new year," Younes Benjelloun, broker at Casablanca Finance Intermediation, told Reuters.
Morocco's largest private conglomerate, ONA closed at 515 dirhams, up five dirhams from Friday.
ONA has diversified stakes in more than 100 companies and a capitalisation of more than 8.3 billion dirhams.
Wafabank, a liquid stock which recently merged with Spanish Uniban bank, shed five dirhams to 550 dirhams.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest capitalisation, gained two dirhams to close at 692 dirhams, traders said.
Sugar firm Cosumar, a subsidiary of ONA group, which controls 80 percent of the local market jumped 30 dirhams to close at 785 dirhams.
Dairy company, Centrale Laitiere, another offshoot of ONA holding, in which French firm Danone has a 20 percent stake, was up 25 dirhams to close at 1,800 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 23.3 million dirhams from 37.5 million on Friday.
